question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Anomaly
solution:
The correct answer is "**Regularity."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• "**Anomaly**" means something that deviates from what is normal or expected.(विसंगति)
 
 
• Example: It is unpleasant to see anomaly in an animal.
 
 
 
• "**Regularity**" means conformity to a rule or principle; consistency.(नियमितता)
 
 
• Example: He exercised with regularity.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the opposite of anomaly is regularity, as it means something that is expected or follows a pattern.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Omen**: a sign or warning of something that will happen in the future.(शकुन)
 
• **Tangible**: perceptible by touch; clear and definite.(वास्तविक)
 
• **Tangent**: a straight line or plane that touches a curve or curved surface at a single point.(स्पर्शरेखा)
